title: B1 · L48 — Giving advice (B1)
topic: Giving thoughtful advice at B1 level
description: Estructuras para dar consejos con matices: If I were you, You should have, Have you thought about, You might want to.

questions.prompt: Situación: tu amigo discutió con su pareja y te pide consejo.
questions.question: Complete: 'If I ___ you, I would apologise.'
questions.explanation: 'If I WERE you' es fórmula fija de segundo condicional para consejos hipotéticos. 'Were' se usa para TODAS las personas (I/he/she/it) en este contexto — es el llamado 'subjuntivo were'. Error TOP del hispanohablante: 'if I was you' — muy común en habla informal pero incorrecto en registro cuidado.
examples: If I were you, I would take that job — it sounds perfect. → consejo directo
If I were you, I'd talk to her directly — no games. → consejo relacional

questions.prompt: Alguien no te informó de un problema y ahora es tarde.
questions.question: Choose: 'You ___ have told me earlier — I could have helped.'
questions.explanation: 'You should have + participio' = crítica constructiva o consejo tardío sobre algo que no se hizo pero era lo correcto. 'Must have' expresa deducción del pasado (no consejo). 'Can/will' no funcionan con estructura pasada. Contracción hablada: 'shoulda' /ˈʃʊdə/. Tono: entre lamento y reproche suave.
examples: You should have called me — I was worried sick. → reproche cariñoso
You should have studied more — the exam was tough. → consejo retrospectivo

questions.statement: 'Have you thought about...?' is a polite way to suggest an idea or advice.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. 'Have you thought about + gerundio/sustantivo?' es sugerencia indirecta y educada. No impone — invita a reflexionar. Muy útil cuando no quieres sonar mandón o cuando la otra persona es sensible. Alternativas B1: 'What if you...?', 'Maybe you could...', 'It might be worth + gerundio'.
examples: Have you thought about talking to her? Might clear the air. → sugerencia relacional
Have you thought about a different approach? Just an idea. → apertura de opciones

questions.text: If I were you I would talk to your manager about it as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: Nota 'I were' con 'were' débil /wə/. 'Would' se contrae a 'I'd' en habla ('I'd talk'). 'About it' con enlace /aʊtɪt/. 'As soon as possible' con /s/+/p/ que casi funden. Estructura clásica B1 de consejo urgente: 'If I were you, I'd + inf + as soon as possible'.
examples: If I were you, I'd act quickly before the offer expires. → consejo urgente
If I were you, I'd contact them immediately — don't wait. → contexto emergencia

questions.prompt: Sugieres a un amigo que reflexione antes de decidir.
questions.question: Complete: 'You ___ want to consider all your options first.'
questions.explanation: 'You might want to + inf' es el consejo MÁS SUAVE en inglés — casi susurrado. Ideal cuando no quieres presionar. 'Should' es más firme, 'must' es obligatorio, 'will' no forma consejo. Escala de intensidad B1: might want to (suave) < could (neutro) < should (firme) < had better (grave) < must (obligatorio).
examples: You might want to check the details first — just to be safe. → precaución
You might want to try a different approach — this isn't working. → sugerencia amable

questions.prompt: Empareja cada fórmula de consejo con su función:
questions.explanation: Cuatro estructuras clave B1 con distinto matiz temporal y de intensidad. Regla de oro: elegir bien la estructura evita conflictos. 'If I were you' es empático; 'you should' es asertivo; 'you might want to' es delicado; 'you should have' es retrospectivo (a veces con reproche).
examples: You might want to reconsider — it's a big decision. → decisión importante
You should have booked earlier — hotels are full now. → consecuencia visible

questions.prompt: Identifica la forma más delicada de sugerir algo.
questions.question: Choose the SOFTEST way to give advice:
questions.explanation: 'You might consider + gerundio' es la forma MÁS SUAVE — combina 'might' (posibilidad) + 'consider' (reflexionar) + gerundio (opción, no obligación). Las otras tres son directas o imperativas. Escala inversa: 'must/have to' (obligación) > 'do it now' (orden) > 'you might consider' (sugerencia mínima).
examples: You might consider talking to a specialist — just an idea. → tema delicado
You might consider taking a break — you look exhausted. → observación cuidada

questions.target: If I were you I would take some time to think about it before deciding.
questions.explanation: Situación: un amigo debe tomar una decisión importante y te pide opinión. Combina segundo condicional ('If I were you, I'd') + consejo práctico ('take some time to think'). Fórmula clásica para decisiones grandes. Contracción 'I'd' natural. Tono empático, sin presión temporal, con matiz de reflexión.
examples: If I were you, I'd sleep on it — decisions look different in the morning. → refrán integrado
If I were you, I'd get a second opinion before you sign anything. → advertencia prudente

questions.statement: 'Why don't you...?' is a common way to give friendly advice.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. 'Why don't you + inf' = ¿por qué no...?, sugerencia amistosa muy natural. Forma pregunta pero función de consejo suave. Alternativas B1 similares: 'Why not + inf', 'How about + gerundio?', 'What about + gerundio?'. Tono cálido, típico entre amigos o familia.
examples: Why don't you take a break? You've been at it for hours. → observación con propuesta
Why don't you ask for help? Everyone needs it sometimes. → normaliza la petición

questions.prompt: Adviertes a alguien sobre un síntoma preocupante.
questions.question: Complete: 'You ___ better talk to a doctor about that.'
questions.explanation: 'You had better + inf' (contracción 'you'd better' o 'you better' en habla rápida) es consejo FUERTE con implicación de consecuencias negativas si no se sigue. Más grave que 'should', menos que 'must'. Nunca 'you have better' o 'you would better' — solo 'you had better'. En negativa: 'You'd better not.'
examples: You'd better leave now — it's getting late and dangerous. → advertencia con motivo
You'd better call her back soon or she'll be furious. → consecuencia anticipada

questions.text: Have you thought about taking some time off to recharge your batteries?
questions.explanation: Nota 'thought' /θɔːt/ con /θ/ dental. 'Time off' es sustantivo con 'off' fijo (vacaciones). 'Recharge your batteries' es modismo fijo — descansar, no literal. 'Take time off' + 'recharge batteries' es combinación B1 idiomática muy natural. 'To' débil /tə/ en habla rápida.
examples: Have you thought about a holiday? Even a long weekend helps. → alternativa asequible
Have you thought about changing jobs? You seem unhappy lately. → observación empática

questions.prompt: Identifica la única fórmula de consejo retrospectivo.
questions.question: Which expression gives ADVICE ABOUT THE PAST?
questions.explanation: 'You should have + participio' es la ÚNICA estructura para consejos sobre el pasado — con matiz crítico o de arrepentimiento. Las otras hablan de presente/futuro. Contracción hablada: 'shoulda studied' /ˈʃʊdə ˈstʌdid/. Uso emocional: entre reproche cariñoso y consejo tardío.
examples: You should have listened to me — I told you this would happen. → 'te lo dije' educado
You should have prepared better — the interview was tough. → consejo retrospectivo

questions.statement: 'My advice would be to...' is a formal way to give advice.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. 'My advice would be to + inf' = fórmula formal/profesional para dar consejo. Distancia emocional que suaviza la asertividad. Ideal en contextos laborales, coaching, mentoría. 'Advice' /ədˈvaɪs/ es INCONTABLE — nunca '*an advice*' o '*advices*'; se dice 'a piece of advice'.
examples: My advice would be to wait a few days before responding. → consejo profesional
My advice would be to talk to HR about it discreetly. → contexto laboral sensible

questions.prompt: Te pones en el lugar de otro para aconsejar.
questions.question: Complete: 'If I were in your ___, I'd accept the offer.'
questions.explanation: 'In your shoes' (idiomático, coloquial) e 'in your position' (más formal) son ambos correctos — expresiones equivalentes de empatía. 'Place' funcionaría solo con 'in someone's place' (menos común). 'Chair' es literal, no idiomático. Error del hispanohablante: 'in your skin' calcando 'en tu piel' — no existe en inglés.
examples: If I were in your shoes, I'd say yes — opportunities like this are rare. → coloquial
In your position, I would apply immediately — nothing to lose. → registro más formal

questions.target: If I were you I would take the job because it offers great opportunities.
questions.explanation: Situación: aconsejas a un amigo sobre aceptar una oferta laboral. Estructura B1 completa: 'If I were you, I'd + inf + because + razón'. La razón hace el consejo persuasivo — sin ella, suena arbitrario. Contracción 'I'd' natural. Tono directo pero empático, apoyado en argumento concreto.
examples: If I were you, I'd study abroad — it's a life-changing experience. → apoyo con superlativo
If I were you, I'd move — you'll grow so much more professionally. → beneficio a largo plazo
